scope: Download-directory cleanup and multiple independently preserved update paths
behavior: Download cleanup runs before result is returned on success, failure and cancellation
Removal requires own storage parent, download-UUID shape, unchanged directory identity and non-alias location
Download record kind permits only its exact download-UUID namespace
Multiple preservation entries carry independent recorded flags and remain distinct from app version result
CLI and model expose direct paths even when a secondary record cannot be saved
validationBoundary: Signed synthetic app updates run in owned temporary directories. Cleanup errors and path replacement are injected; no user data or real OS permission faults are used.
compatibility: Optional kind/additionalPreservedWorkspaces fields; old prepared workspace kind nil and legacy single-preservation fields remain supported. workspacePreservations is an in-memory aggregate, not a duplicate JSON field.
limits: No fresh visible GUI acceptance with two simultaneous pending paths; model and backend tests cover this case
Storage/journal persistence remains best effort under I/O failure
Directory checks do not eliminate all namespace races or seal deep contents
Historical source-image residual mechanism remains open
No real installed app replacement, root query, helper installation, hardware writes or release
build: passed as part of full regression
